sources.title: SimCity 2013 player screenshots
sources.finding: Visually inspected town and downtown: roof equipment, facade hierarchy, planted lots and a strong colour range. Interpretation from images, not a polygon-cost measurement.

sources.title: SimCity pre-release screenshots, November 2012
sources.finding: Visually inspected the city overview. Pre-release reference; the article itself questions whether an early image is concept work. Not a shipped-quality guarantee.

sources.title: Cities: Skylines II Steam screenshot post, June 2023
sources.finding: Visually inspected overview and street: fine facade divisions, window/interior variation, signage and detailed street edges. Promotional images, not performance evidence.

sources.title: Eugene Wong — SimCity 2013 building art direction
sources.finding: Primary source: geometry/texturing benchmarks, procedural atlas overlays and ground textures/props were part of the building workflow.

sources.title: Colossal Order — Creating an Asset Pack
sources.finding: Primary source: references and scale blockouts precede iterative architectural details. Visually inspected the waterfront example for railings, paving, roof articulation and planting.

sources.title: Poly Haven — Brick Wall 001
sources.finding: CC0 photographed brick, 3 metre width; Dimitrios Savva photography and Rob Tuytel processing. The pilot embeds 2K diffuse, OpenGL normal and roughness maps.

sources.title: Poly Haven asset licence
sources.finding: CC0 applies to downloaded asset files. Source credit retained.

conclusion: Increase construction hierarchy, material variation and lot detail together; establish achievable quality with actual imported captures. No production-quality or performance equivalence claimed.
texture_application: The brick image has about five stretchers across. The pilot maps it over 1.2 metres to obtain approximately 24 cm courses horizontally, rather than using the catalogue 3 m width literally.
